classes.name: DateTimeWizard
classes.description: Abstract class providing utility methods for handling date-time related formatting, including padding separators, escaping characters, wrapping literals, and string representation.

methods.name: padSeparatorArray
methods.description: Pads the separator array to ensure it has a specified count by repeating the last separator.

methods.name: escapeSingleCharacter
methods.description: Escapes a single character unless it is one of the characters that do not need escaping.

methods.name: wrapLiteral
methods.description: Wraps a string literal in quotes or escapes it if it is a single character.

methods.name: intersperse
methods.description: Concatenates a format block with an optional separator.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the object, delegating to the format method (not shown in the snippet).
